About.Name: Tamana Muhseny
About.AboutText:
Hi, I am Tamana Muhseny, Electrical Engineering student at Seattle Pacific University.

I am dedicated to building a career in Electrical Engineering field. I mainly enjoy practical and hands-on works.

I have enjoyed my classroom circuitry projects.

Beyond the classroom, I have been member Falcon Racing: Baja club on campus. By participating in this club I have learned team work and analyzing problems from different perspectives.

Experience.ExperienceText:
I am an Electrical Engineering student at Seattle Pacific University.

As a student I have been able to develop skills such as reading schematics, problems solving, and troubleshooting though my classes.

And I am looking forward to utilize these skills in my career beyond college classes.
Experience.EducationText: Currently pursuing a degree in Electrical Engineering, where I am building a strong foundation in circuits analysis, schematic reading, and problem solving.
Experience.EmploymentText: As a learning assistant I had the chance to help students with homework and in-class questions.
Experience.SkillsText: I have used C++ and Python for my class projects. As well as Multisim, Altium Designer, and Oscilloscope.
